channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: DWP confirms State Pension payment changes for Christmas 2025 and New Year
item.description: The Department for Work and Pensions has confirmed that millions of people will see their State Pension payments arrive early this Christmas and New Year.

item.title: Martin Lewis issues urgent warning to viewers: 'it is a lie. It is a scam'
item.description: Martin Lewis has issued an urgent scam warning: Any advert or social media clip with him suggesting you should invest is a scam and a lie

item.title: Follow these 5 tips including eating these 11 foods to boost your skin this winter
item.description: A skincare professional has shared five tips you should follow for clear skin this winter, and they are super easy!

item.title: Ricky Gervais donates £2.5m of tour proceeds to 22 animal charities
item.description: Ricky Gervais has donated almost £2.5m from his Mortality tour proceeds to animal charities

item.title: 2 popular channels axed from Freeview after 23 years on the air
item.description: Two long-running channels once loved by children have been axed from Freeview this week after more than 20 years on the air.

item.title: 277-home scheme rejected by Conwy councillors - for now
item.description: A bid to build hundreds of homes in a field near Abergele has been thrown out by councillors - but they have been warned the application might return on appeal.

item.title: Conwy bar to re-open after customers sustain 'minor injuries' in ceiling collapse
item.description: A bar in Conwy will re-open today (December 12) after Storm Bram caused a portion of its ceiling to collapse, which lead to some customers sustaining minor injuries.

item.title: Met Office issues weather warning for heavy rain across North Wales this weekend
item.description: The Met Office has issued a weather warning for heavy rain across North Wales this weekend.

item.title: Controversial plan for six-bedroom Llandudno home to become HMO finally approved
item.description: A controversial retrospective application to convert a home to a six-bedroom House of Multiple Occupation (HMO) in Llandudno has been approved by Conwy County Council’s planning committee.

item.title: Housing need trumps flood concerns as councillors greenlight Llandudno homes plan
item.description: CONWY councillors have reaffirmed their decision to approve a new affordable housing estate in Llandudno near Ffordd Penrhyn.
